J1.evidence: The source reads «ولو نويت الفاطرَ الخالِق» (definite, with al-). EN silently changes it to 'fāṭiran' (indefinite, transliterated), which translates a different text. EN also adds an unmarked bracket '[i.e. as an indefinite participle]' that is not in the Arabic. Both must go into a [Translator's note: …] or be rendered as written. TR keeps «الفاطرَ الخالِق» as is.

J2.evidence: The source reads 'ولو نويت الفاطرَ الخالِق نصبته على القطع؛ إذ لم يكن فيه ألف ولام'. EN renders الفاطرَ as 'fāṭiran', which translates a different text (indefinite فاطرا, not what is written) and also transliterates the Quranic word فاطر in Latin letters. It adds '[i.e. as an indefinite participle]' without a Translator's note. Minor: 'وهو معرفة' is rendered 'since it is definite', which adds a causal link.
